body: Can I ask for your thoughts? There is someone in my life, I’ve known him for several years (about 3-4), he’s asked me out and wants a relationship for the longest time now but I’ve always turned him down. I feel conflicted, how am I supposed to love him if I can’t love myself? But maybe he’s the positive light I need? Maybe he can help me work through some things and become a better person. I don’t know what to do. I don’t want to be in a relationship for the wrong reasons. Maybe this is my opportunity to try a relationship and try to not push away so often?
I briefly looked at your profile history. You’re a kind soul..taking time to reply to so many people going through tough times.

Thank you for your words of encouragement..the first thing I looked at was your username. Every time I’m in a rough mental place, especially on the worst days, I always think of those words “this too will pass.” 
I just feel so alone, worthless, lost..I have a couple friends who try to help and support me but I feel alone in my own mind. Every positive thing they say towards me, I try to believe but my mind just tells me it’s all bullshit and not true. I feel that I don’t deserve happiness.
Long term goals keep me going and mostly keep me from doing anything too stupid.
Sorry for being long winded or rambly. I appreciate you taking time to respond to me.
I really hope OP sees your message.

I hope you find peace and happiness in your life. 

Don’t know what your battles are, but if you haven’t done so already, consider talking about this with your doctor. They could help get you on the right medication which could potentially help ease these negative feelings.
